answers.final_answer: public static int countUpper(String s) { int count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) { String c = s.substring(i, i + 1); if (c.compareTo("A") >= 0 && c.compareTo("Z") <= 0) count++; } return count; }
